dashboard.emptyStateStep1Desc: Give the assessment a name your students will recognise (e.g. "Grade 7 Reading — May 26").
dashboard.emptyStateStep2Desc: Select an MP3 or WAV file from your computer. WAV files convert to MP3 automatically.
dashboard.emptyStateStep3Desc: Give the student the access code. Keep the exit word private — only read it aloud when the assessment is done.

onboarding.step1Body: Create audio and text accommodations for your assessments in under a minute. No credit card needed — just sign in and go.
onboarding.step2Body: Paste your assessment text here, or switch to Audio mode and upload an MP3 or WAV file. You can even include images in text assessments.
onboarding.step3Body: After you create an assessment, you'll get an access code like ABC-123. Share this code with your students — that's all they need.
onboarding.step4Body: Students open the AudioProctor Chrome extension on their Chromebook, enter the code, and complete the assessment. They'll need the exit word when they're done.
onboarding.step5Body: That's the whole workflow. Ready to create your first assessment? You can revisit this tutorial anytime by clicking the help icon.
